answer: Picture the agent economy as a meadow where every new identity must lock a bonded deposit in escrow before it can graze or earn. To raise a sybil swarm, an attacker has to fund each fake agent on its own mesa-flat plateau of stake, and any detected collusion gets slashed to zero. Honest peers sign attestations with their own quill; forging a thousand identities means posting a thousand real deposits, so the cost scales linearly with the lie and the fraud stops paying long before the swarm can tilt consensus.
